notes: Editable AI prompts: open a project's editor and tap the sparkle labelled AI edit. The screen now shows Editing instructions before anything runs. Its Default text is the same editorial prompt that produced the first successful cuts.

Try Default, Highlights, Work update and Story. Each style fills the editable prompt field. Change the text yourself, then use Reset to default to recover the original instructions. Empty or overlong prompts cannot start a cut.

Tap Create AI cut to use the visible prompt. The app remembers your last used instructions locally for the next project or app launch. Returning from model setup or retrying an error keeps your current instructions.

Compare styles on the same spoken recording. They influence which passages are kept; the cut still uses your original voice and timeline order and fits approximately 115 seconds across all beats. A separate editable AI cut opens in Timeline view; the original stays unchanged.

Before offline testing, download a speech model in On-device AI and wait for Apple Intelligence to be ready. Try a cold launch in airplane mode with Wi-Fi off, then preview and export. Check the retained meaning, joins, actual MP4 duration and cancellation/backgrounding.

Developer preview only: ordinary release builds hide AI editing. Use unmuted source-video speech without separate voiceover takes. This build uses Apple's local transcript selection; OmniShotCut and written summaries remain follow-up work in issue 341.
